rationale: The Product A control plane gains a sequencer transport loop capability pair -- a Sensitive read of the master transport's published loop and a Control write applying action-discriminated set-range/set-enabled edits -- so Forge Sequencer and Forge Modular reach loop state through the unified capability surfaces (CLI, MCP, grant policy, installed CMake package) rather than a CLI-only side door. visual-proof-harness is crossed by exactly one line of test/cmake/view_widget_bridge_tests.cmake, which that family's selector owns: the manifest registers the new pulp-test-control-sequencer-transport-executor target. No screenshot, capture, golden, fixture, snapshot, threshold, renderer, backend, asset or font behaviour changes, and no existing target's registration is altered. No DSP and no core/playback change: the executor calls MasterTransport's existing public set_loop and playhead readers. Registered watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
